scope: Staging frontend only; no CRM data mutation or direct external send

pension.cause: Provider/account-only keys collapsed separate pension plans; balance aggregation omitted other reported contribution components.
pension.fix: Pension plan/type discriminator; sum reported PerutYitrot balances once; preserve zero versus missing.
pension.recovery: Explicit source re-upload repairs matching legacy plan IDs and adds missing funds without duplicating report history. Existing completed-workflow import safeguards remain.
pension.verification: Four source funds with exact balances; repeat import idempotent; original product references and notes retained.

display: Product monetary amounts rounded to whole ILS for display only. Stored values and fee percentages unchanged.

calendar.recovery: Pending IDs saved in sessionStorage after CRM save and before sync; resume on same-tab reload. Old unmarked unsynced appointments still need manual initial sync.
calendar.limits: Browser-open retries only; no background scheduler. Explicit validation, permission and conflict errors do not retry automatically.
calendar.verification: Synthetic UI initial failure retried automatically; same-event edits/cancellation pass; bounded retry and pending persistence tests pass.
